summary: The revision is an early envelope layout rather than a complete manufacturable enclosure. Major volumes are visible, but required interface and manufacturing details are absent or not visually verifiable.

checks.description: The assembly consists of simplified stacked envelopes and a base without a complete enclosing or retention structure.

evidence.description: The isometric view shows stacked component envelopes on a base rather than a finished enclosure.

checks.description: The Mini-ITX mounting pattern, retention hardware, and accessible rear-I/O opening cannot be established.

evidence.description: A board-sized central volume is visible, but standoffs, fasteners, and a rear-I/O aperture are not visible.

checks.description: No completed side panel or visible intake gap is available to verify cooler side-intake clearance.

evidence.description: The cooler envelope is visible without a completed side-panel clearance relationship.

checks.description: The GPU I/O bracket, PCIe riser, and power-cable bend space cannot be verified.

evidence.description: The GPU-sized envelope has no visually identifiable bracket, riser, connector, or cable-routing features.

checks.description: No identifiable Flex ATX/1U or SFX PSU, AC inlet, airflow path, mounting provision, or cable route is visible.

evidence.description: No PSU-specific volume, mount, inlet, ventilation, or cable geometry is visually identifiable.

checks.description: No externally accessible power button or internal motherboard-header routing feature is visibly present.

evidence.description: The visible geometry has no identifiable button opening, button body, or wire-routing feature.

checks.description: The chassis boundary and motherboard, cooler, and GPU concept envelopes are visually distinguishable; incomplete containment is also visible.

evidence.description: The isometric view clearly separates the base boundary and principal stacked component envelopes.

checks.description: The revision lacks a complete FDM enclosure, dual-side mesh, removable-panel details, PSU mount, power button, and complete hardware retention structure.

evidence.description: The incomplete geometry visibly lacks mesh, panel joints, PSU mounting, a button, and detailed retention features.
